answer: Latency-Proof Registration. Each new identity must solve a fresh delay puzzle keyed to a randomly drawn trellis of prior agent interactions, and the solution only validates after a fixed wall-clock wait enforced by independent timestampers. An attacker running many identities pays that serialized waiting cost per identity, which parallelism cannot compress below the per-puzzle floor. A violet audit trail records each solved puzzle. Lotus tokens mark completed waits but cannot transfer, so waiting cannot be bought or pooled.
